headword: {温室|おんしつ}{効果|こうか}ガス

definitions.explanation: a gas in the atmosphere that traps heat from the sun, contributing to the greenhouse effect and global warming

examples.japanese: {温室|おんしつ}{効果|こうか}ガスの{排出|はいしゅつ}を{減|へ}らす。
{二酸化炭素|にさんかたんそ}は{代表的|だいひょうてき}な{温室|おんしつ}{効果|こうか}ガスだ。
examples.english: Carbon dioxide is a typical greenhouse gas.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}は2050{年|ねん}までに{温室|おんしつ}{効果|こうか}ガスの{排出|はいしゅつ}を{実質|じっしつ}ゼロにする{目標|もくひょう}を{掲|かか}げている。
examples.english: Japan has set a target of achieving net-zero greenhouse gas emissions by 2050.

notes:
The standard Japanese term for greenhouse gases. Composed of {温室|おんしつ} (greenhouse) + {効果|こうか} (effect) + ガス (gas). Extremely common in environmental news, policy discussions, and climate change reporting.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {温室|おんしつ}{効果|こうか}ガスの{排出|はいしゅつ} — greenhouse gas emissions
- {温室|おんしつ}{効果|こうか}ガスの{削減|さくげん} — greenhouse gas reduction
- {温室|おんしつ}{効果|こうか}ガス{排出量|はいしゅつりょう} — greenhouse gas emission levels
- {温室|おんしつ}{効果|こうか}ガス{濃度|のうど} — greenhouse gas concentration

MAJOR GREENHOUSE GASES:
- {二酸化炭素|にさんかたんそ} (CO2) — carbon dioxide (largest contributor)
- メタン (CH4) — methane
- {一酸化二窒素|いっさんかにちっそ} (N2O) — nitrous oxide
- フロン — chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {温室|おんしつ}{効果|こうか} — the greenhouse effect (the phenomenon itself)
- {地球|ちきゅう}{温暖化|おんだんか} — global warming
- {脱炭素|だつたんそ} — decarbonization
